header: US 2010/0041557 A1 at the left, Feb. 18, 2010 at the right, and the page number 4 centred on the line below. Three separate items of running furniture, not body content.

paragraphs.zh: The production of the form C of tembotrione according to the invention is effected by
paragraphs.en: The production of the form C of tembotrione according to the invention is effected by
paragraphs.notes: Opens a two-item list continued in [0046] and [0047], which are printed indented under it. Ends without a full stop, as printed. This and every paragraph through [0062] is presented as the invention's own process.

paragraphs.zh: crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in 2,2-dimethylpropanol (tert. amyl alcohol); or
paragraphs.en: crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in 2,2-dimethylpropanol (tert. amyl alcohol); or
paragraphs.notes: Printed indented as the first item of the list opened by [0045]. Read off the image as 2,2-dimethylpropanol with a comma locant; the text layer has 2.2- in the parallel sentence at [0052].

paragraphs.zh: crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in an aromatic solvent or in a mixture of an aromatic solvent with an aliphatic solvent.
paragraphs.en: crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in an aromatic solvent or in a mixture of an aromatic solvent with an aliphatic solvent.
paragraphs.notes: Printed indented as the second item of the list opened by [0045].

paragraphs.zh: For this, in a first step i) a hot solution of tembotrione in is prepared, and then in a second step ii) crystallization of the tembotrione is effected by rapid cooling.
paragraphs.en: For this, in a first step i) a hot solution of tembotrione in is prepared, and then in a second step ii) crystallization of the tembotrione is effected by rapid cooling.
paragraphs.notes: "a hot solution of tembotrione in is prepared" is exactly what the page prints: the solvent name is missing after "in". Checked at high magnification on the image, so this is a defect in the printed original and not an OCR drop or a transcription slip. Left as printed.

paragraphs.zh: The term “hot solution” means a solution having a temperature of at least 80° C., in particular at least 90° C. and more preferably at least 100° C.
paragraphs.en: The term “hot solution” means a solution having a temperature of at least 80° C., in particular at least 90° C. and more preferably at least 100° C.
paragraphs.notes: Curly quotes as printed. The page sets the temperature unit as a degree sign, a space, then "C." with a full stop; the text layer collapses this to 80°C. in places. The image spacing is followed.

paragraphs.zh: The concentration of tembotrione in the solution used for the crystallization often lies in the range from 100 to 600 g/l, in particular 250 to 400 g/l.
paragraphs.en: The concentration of tembotrione in the solution used for the crystallization often lies in the range from 100 to 600 g/l, in particular 250 to 400 g/l.
paragraphs.notes: The unit is g/l, ending in a lower-case letter L for litre, confirmed on the image. This is the exact place the OCR confusion between the digit 1 and the letter l would do damage, so it was checked at magnification: 600 g/l and 400 g/l, not 600 g/1.

paragraphs.zh: Preferably the solution used for the crystallization contains tembotrione in a purity of at least 85%, often at least 90%, in particular at least 95%, i.e. the content of organic impurities which are not organic solvents is not more than 15 wt. %, often not more than 10 wt. %, and in particular not more than 5 wt. %, based on the tembotrione present dissolved in the solution.
paragraphs.en: Preferably the solution used for the crystallization contains tembotrione in a purity of at least 85%, often at least 90%, in particular at least 95%, i.e. the content of organic impurities which are not organic solvents is not more than 15 wt. %, often not more than 10 wt. %, and in particular not more than 5 wt. %, based on the tembotrione present dissolved in the solution.
paragraphs.notes: The page sets "wt. %" with a space inside; purities are set as bare "85%" with no space. Both forms are kept as printed. "dissolved" was hyphenated across a line break as "dis-solved" and is rejoined.

paragraphs.zh: According to a first embodiment, form C is prepared by crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in 2,2-dimethylpropanol (tert. amyl alcohol). The solution used for the crystallization is then preferably essentially free from solvents other than 2,2-dimethyl-propanol. In this context, “essentially free” means that the concentration of solvents including water which are different from 2,2-dimethylpropanol in the tembotrione-containing solution does not exceed 10 wt. % and often 5 wt. %, based on the total quantity of solvent.
paragraphs.en: According to a first embodiment, form C is prepared by crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in 2,2-dimethylpropanol (tert. amyl alcohol). The solution used for the crystallization is then preferably essentially free from solvents other than 2,2-dimethyl-propanol. In this context, “essentially free” means that the concentration of solvents including water which are different from 2,2-dimethylpropanol in the tembotrione-containing solution does not exceed 10 wt. % and often 5 wt. %, based on the total quantity of solvent.
paragraphs.notes: Three points of care. First, the locants are commas: 2,2-, verified at magnification, against the text layer which reads 2.2- here. Second, the second occurrence is printed mid-line as "2,2-dimethyl-propanol", with a real hyphen between "dimethyl" and "propanol" that is not a line break; the first and third occurrences have no such hyphen. The page is internally inconsistent about this name and both forms are kept as printed. Third, the third occurrence was broken across a line as "2,2-dimethylpro-panol" and is rejoined. Chemistry note: the page glosses 2,2-dimethylpropanol as tert. amyl alcohol, and those are two different compounds. Recorded, not corrected. See discrepancies.

paragraphs.zh: According to a second embodiment, form C is prepared by crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in an aromatic hydrocarbon solvent or in a mixture of an aromatic hydrocarbon solvent with an aliphatic hydrocarbon solvent. Suitable aromatic hydrocarbon solvents include, e.g., toluene, xylenes, mesitylene, cumene (isopropylbenzene), ethylbenzene, ethyltoluenes, cymenes (isopropyltoluenes) such as m- and p-cymene, and mixtures thereof. Suitable aliphatic hydrocarbon solvents include saturated linear, branched or cyclic hydrocarbons such as n-hexane, n-heptane, n-octane and their branched isomers, cyclopentane, cyclohexane, methylcyclohexane, cylcoheptane and cyclooctane. If a mixture of an aromatic and an aliphatic solvent is used, the volume ratio of aromatic solvent to aliphatic solvent is preferably from 20:80 to 99:1, in particular from 30:70 to 95:5 v/v. The solution used for the crystallization is then preferably essentially free from solvents other than aromatic and aliphatic hydrocarbon solvents. In this context, “essentially free” means that the concentration of solvents including water which are different from hydrocarbon solvents in the tembotrione-containing solution does not exceed 10 wt. % and often 5 wt. %, based on the total quantity of solvent.
paragraphs.en: According to a second embodiment, form C is prepared by crystallization from a hot solution of tembotrione in an aromatic hydrocarbon solvent or in a mixture of an aromatic hydrocarbon solvent with an aliphatic hydrocarbon solvent. Suitable aromatic hydrocarbon solvents include, e.g., toluene, xylenes, mesitylene, cumene (isopropylbenzene), ethylbenzene, ethyltoluenes, cymenes (isopropyltoluenes) such as m- and p-cymene, and mixtures thereof. Suitable aliphatic hydrocarbon solvents include saturated linear, branched or cyclic hydrocarbons such as n-hexane, n-heptane, n-octane and their branched isomers, cyclopentane, cyclohexane, methylcyclohexane, cylcoheptane and cyclooctane. If a mixture of an aromatic and an aliphatic solvent is used, the volume ratio of aromatic solvent to aliphatic solvent is preferably from 20:80 to 99:1, in particular from 30:70 to 95:5 v/v. The solution used for the crystallization is then preferably essentially free from solvents other than aromatic and aliphatic hydrocarbon solvents. In this context, “essentially free” means that the concentration of solvents including water which are different from hydrocarbon solvents in the tembotrione-containing solution does not exceed 10 wt. % and often 5 wt. %, based on the total quantity of solvent.
paragraphs.notes: The two solvent lists on this page. Both were read name by name off the image at magnification, all nineteen names, and the sentence-class openings ("Suitable aromatic hydrocarbon solvents include" and "Suitable aliphatic hydrocarbon solvents include") are kept with their members. "cylcoheptane" is printed exactly so, with the l and c transposed from cycloheptane; verified at magnification and left as printed rather than silently corrected, since it is the printed original's typo and not mine. Words broken across line ends and rejoined here: "pre-pared", "aro-matic", "n-hep-tane" to n-heptane, "cyclooc-tane" to cyclooctane, "essen-tially". The ratios 20:80, 99:1, 30:70 and 95:5 v/v were each checked digit by digit on the image.

paragraphs.zh: For the preparation of the solution, essentially any known form of tembotrione can be used. Often amorphous tembotrione or a mixture of different crystalline modifications or a mixture of amorphous and crystalline tembotrione will be used. Also suitable are crystalline forms of tembotrione and mixtures thereof, for example the form A according to the invention described above and the form B also described here, not according to the invention, and mixtures of these forms.
paragraphs.en: For the preparation of the solution, essentially any known form of tembotrione can be used. Often amorphous tembotrione or a mixture of different crystalline modifications or a mixture of amorphous and crystalline tembotrione will be used. Also suitable are crystalline forms of tembotrione and mixtures thereof, for example the form A according to the invention described above and the form B also described here, not according to the invention, and mixtures of these forms.
paragraphs.notes: States plainly that form A is according to the invention and form B is not. Rejoined across line breaks: "modifica-tions", "tembotri-one". The text layer ran "amorphous and" together as "amorphousand"; the image has the space.

paragraphs.zh: The dissolution of the tembotrione in 2,2-dimethylpropanol is usually effected at temperatures in the range from 80 to 150° C., in particular in the range from 90 to 130° C., in particular from 100 to 120° C. and often at the boiling point of the respective solvent or solvent mixture used for the crystallization of tembotrione, e.g. at the boiling point of 2,2-dimethylpropanol or at the boiling point of the hydrocarbon solvent or solvent mixture.
paragraphs.en: The dissolution of the tembotrione in 2,2-dimethylpropanol is usually effected at temperatures in the range from 80 to 150° C., in particular in the range from 90 to 130° C., in particular from 100 to 120° C. and often at the boiling point of the respective solvent or solvent mixture used for the crystallization of tembotrione, e.g. at the boiling point of 2,2-dimethylpropanol or at the boiling point of the hydrocarbon solvent or solvent mixture.
paragraphs.notes: Both occurrences of 2,2-dimethylpropanol were broken across line ends here ("2,2-dimethyl-propanol" and "2,2-dim-ethylpropanol") and are rejoined without a hyphen, unlike the deliberate mid-line hyphen at [0052]. Also rejoined: "crystal-lization", "sol-vent". Temperatures 80, 150, 90, 130, 100, 120 all checked on the image.

paragraphs.zh: The crystallization of form C of tembotrione is effected according to the invention by cooling of the hot solution of tembotrione in the respective solvent. According to a preferred embodiment, cooling is performed rapidly. This is understood to mean that the solution is cooled at a cooling rate of at least 30 K/hr, for example at a cooling rate of 30 to 120 K/hr. Rapid cooling is not necessary, when seed crystals of form C are used.
paragraphs.en: The crystallization of form C of tembotrione is effected according to the invention by cooling of the hot solution of tembotrione in the respective solvent. According to a preferred embodiment, cooling is performed rapidly. This is understood to mean that the solution is cooled at a cooling rate of at least 30 K/hr, for example at a cooling rate of 30 to 120 K/hr. Rapid cooling is not necessary, when seed crystals of form C are used.
paragraphs.notes: Cooling rates 30 K/hr and 30 to 120 K/hr checked at magnification. The comma in "not necessary, when" is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Preferably, the crystallization is performed in a way that the beginning of the crystallization process occurs at a temperature of at least 80° C., more preferably of temperature of at least 90° C. in particular at least 100° C.
paragraphs.en: Preferably, the crystallization is performed in a way that the beginning of the crystallization process occurs at a temperature of at least 80° C., more preferably of temperature of at least 90° C. in particular at least 100° C.
paragraphs.notes: "more preferably of temperature of" and the missing comma before "in particular" are both as printed; verified at magnification. Not normalised.

paragraphs.zh: The crystallization is as a rule carried out until at least 60 wt. %, preferably at least 80 wt. %, of the tembotrione used crystallizes out.
paragraphs.en: The crystallization is as a rule carried out until at least 60 wt. %, preferably at least 80 wt. %, of the tembotrione used crystallizes out.

paragraphs.zh: The crystallization of form C can be promoted or accelerated by seeding with seed crystals of form C, for example by adding seed crystals of form C before or during the crystallization.
paragraphs.en: The crystallization of form C can be promoted or accelerated by seeding with seed crystals of form C, for example by adding seed crystals of form C before or during the crystallization.

paragraphs.zh: If seed crystals are added during the crystallization, the quantity thereof is typically 0.001 to 10 wt. %, often 0.005 to 5 wt. %, in particular 0.01 to 1 wt. % and especially 0.05 to 0.5 wt. %, based on the dissolved tembotrione. If the crystallization is performed in the presence of seed crystals of form C, these are preferably only added at a temperature at which the saturation concentration of the tembotrione in the solvent in question has been reached, i.e. at or below that temperature at which the dissolved quantity of tembotrione forms a saturated solution in the respective solvent (e.g. 2,2-dimethylpropanol or hydrocarbon solvent/solvent mixture). The person skilled in the art can determine the temperature dependence of the saturation concentration in a solvent in routine experiments.
paragraphs.en: If seed crystals are added during the crystallization, the quantity thereof is typically 0.001 to 10 wt. %, often 0.005 to 5 wt. %, in particular 0.01 to 1 wt. % and especially 0.05 to 0.5 wt. %, based on the dissolved tembotrione. If the crystallization is performed in the presence of seed crystals of form C, these are preferably only added at a temperature at which the saturation concentration of the tembotrione in the solvent in question has been reached, i.e. at or below that temperature at which the dissolved quantity of tembotrione forms a saturated solution in the respective solvent (e.g. 2,2-dimethylpropanol or hydrocarbon solvent/solvent mixture). The person skilled in the art can determine the temperature dependence of the saturation concentration in a solvent in routine experiments.
paragraphs.notes: Four seed-crystal loadings, each checked digit by digit on the image because the decimal points are exactly where this OCR layer fails: 0.001 to 10, 0.005 to 5, 0.01 to 1, 0.05 to 0.5 wt. %. All are decimal points on the page, not commas. Rejoined across line ends: "crystal-lization", "satu-rated", "2,2-dimethylpro-panol", "experi-ments".

paragraphs.zh: The isolation of the form C from the crystallization product, i.e. the separation of the form C from the mother liquor, is effected by usual techniques such as are described in connection with form A.
paragraphs.en: The isolation of the form C from the crystallization product, i.e. the separation of the form C from the mother liquor, is effected by usual techniques such as are described in connection with form A.
paragraphs.notes: Refers back to a form A isolation description that is not on this page.

paragraphs.zh: By means of the crystallization according to the invention, the form C is obtained with a tembotrione content of as a rule at least 90 wt. %, often at least 94 wt. %, in particular at least 96 wt. %. The content of form C, based on the total quantity of tembotrione, is typically at least 90% and often at least 96%.
paragraphs.en: By means of the crystallization according to the invention, the form C is obtained with a tembotrione content of as a rule at least 90 wt. %, often at least 94 wt. %, in particular at least 96 wt. %. The content of form C, based on the total quantity of tembotrione, is typically at least 90% and often at least 96%.
paragraphs.notes: Note the page's own distinction, kept as printed: the tembotrione content is given in "wt. %" and the form C content in bare "%". 90, 94, 96, 90, 96 all checked on the image.

paragraphs.zh: In connection with the study on the crystallization of tembotrione, a further modification B was found. Unlike the modifications A and C, modification B cannot be stably formulated.
paragraphs.en: In connection with the study on the crystallization of tembotrione, a further modification B was found. Unlike the modifications A and C, modification B cannot be stably formulated.
paragraphs.notes: The page turns here from the invention to form B, which [0054] has already said is not according to the invention. "formulated" was broken as "for-mulated" and is rejoined.

paragraphs.en: The form B can be identified by X-ray powder diffractometry on the basis of its diffraction diagram. Thus an X-ray powder diffraction diagram recorded using Cu-Kα radiation (1.54178 Å) at 25° C. shows at least 3, often at least 5, and especially all of the reflections quoted in the following table as 2θ values or as interplanar spacings d:
paragraphs.notes: Ends the page on a colon: the table of form B reflections it announces is NOT printed on this page and must be picked up on the next page. No rows of it are recorded here. The page prints this reflection source as Cu, then a long dash glyph, then K alpha, i.e. with a long dash between Cu and Kα; transcribed with a plain hyphen as "Cu-Kα" because the repo forbids the em dash character anywhere, and this is the one deliberate departure from the printed glyphs on this page. The wavelength is 1.54178 Å with a decimal point, and the final symbols are Greek alpha and Greek theta: the text layer reduced these to "Cu-KC.", "1.54178 A" and "20 values". "diffractometry" was broken as "dif-fractometry" and is rejoined.

discrepancies.what: The page glosses one alcohol with the name of a different alcohol, and does so twice.
discrepancies.drawing_says: There is no drawing anywhere on this page, so this is not a drawing against prose conflict. It is recorded here because discrepancies is the only field on this schema that travels downstream, and a later pass that resolves either name to a structure will need to know that the page itself is ambiguous.
discrepancies.text_says: [0046] and [0052] both print "2,2-dimethylpropanol (tert. amyl alcohol)". 2,2-dimethylpropanol is neopentyl alcohol, 2,2-dimethyl-1-propanol, a primary alcohol; tert. amyl alcohol is 2-methyl-2-butanol, a tertiary alcohol. They are different compounds and the page treats them as one solvent throughout [0046], [0052], [0055] and [0060]. Both names are transcribed as printed and neither is preferred here.

discrepancies.what: The solvent is missing from the step i) sentence.
discrepancies.text_says: [0048] prints "in a first step i) a hot solution of tembotrione in is prepared", with nothing after "in". From [0046] and [0047] the intended solvent is one of 2,2-dimethylpropanol or an aromatic solvent or aromatic/aliphatic mixture, but the sentence itself does not say so and the gap is left as printed.

discrepancies.what: A solvent name is misspelled in the aliphatic list.
discrepancies.text_says: [0053] prints "cylcoheptane" where cycloheptane is meant, between methylcyclohexane and cyclooctane. Verified at magnification on the image, so the typo is the printed original's. Transcribed as printed; a downstream name-to-structure step will need to know it is a typo and not a different ring size.

discrepancies.what: The table this page's last paragraph announces is not on this page.
discrepancies.drawing_says: No drawing and no table on this page.
discrepancies.text_says: [0064] ends "quoted in the following table as 2θ values or as interplanar spacings d:" and the page stops. The form B reflection table begins on the next page. No rows are recorded here and none should be attributed to p07.

notes:
MARKER FORM, and this contradicts the shared briefing, so flagging it for the run as a whole. The briefing's correction 3 says the paragraph markers on this patent are bare four-digit numbers printed without square brackets. On this page that is wrong. Every marker from [0045] to [0064] is printed WITH square brackets and in bold, checked at high magnification on the image, e.g. "[0045]" and "[0053]". The bare-number form in the briefing is an artifact of the OCR layer, which strips the brackets and then decorates the numbers variously as "0045.", "0046)" and "0047". The image wins, per the briefing's own rule, so the markers here are recorded with brackets. Two independent confirmations that brackets are also what the pipeline requires: MARKER in pipeline/make_visual_evidence.py is re.compile(r"^\\[\\d{4}\\]$") and PARAGRAPH_MARKER in pipeline/verify.py is re.compile(r"^(?:\\[\\d{4}\\]|None\\s)"). A bare 0045 would fail MARKER.match, which would empty the printed list, silently make placed false and drop this page's marker openings without an error. Other pages' vision JSON should use the bracketed form too.
WHAT THIS PAGE ACTUALLY IS. It is not the formulation page. There are no surfactants, carriers, adjuvants or antifoaming agents on it, and no formulation auxiliaries of any kind. It is page 4 of the description, paragraphs [0045] to [0064], and it covers the production of crystalline form C of tembotrione by crystallization, then turns at [0063] to modification B. The two long lists it does carry are solvent lists, both in [0053].
SOURCE LANGUAGE. The patent is in English, so zh and en carry identical strings on every paragraph, per the briefing's correction 1. No normalisation was applied to en beyond what is described next, which was applied to both fields equally.
HYPHENATION. The single normalisation applied: words broken across a line end by the typesetter are rejoined without the hyphen, since that hyphen is typesetting and not content. Each instance is listed in the notes of its own paragraph. Hyphens that are genuinely part of a name or sit mid-line are preserved exactly, including "2,2-dimethyl-propanol" at [0052], "m- and p-cymene", "tembotrione-containing", "X-ray", "n-hexane", "n-heptane" and "n-octane".
PRESENTED AS. Paragraphs [0045] to [0062] are the invention's own process for form C. [0063] and [0064] describe modification B, which [0054] states explicitly is "not according to the invention". Nothing on this page is prior art in the background sense.
TEXT LAYER. /tmp/us2010/page07.txt was used only as a cross-check and was wrong in the ways the briefing predicted. Confirmed failures on this page: locant commas to full stops ("2.2-dimethylpropanol" at [0052] for the printed 2,2-), lost interword spaces ("oftembotrione" repeatedly, "amorphousand" at [0054], "attemperatures" at [0055]), Greek to Latin ("Cu-KC." for Cu-Kα and "20 values" for 2θ values at [0064]), the Angstrom sign flattened to A, spurious capitals ("Solvents", "Xylenes", "Saturated", "Volume"), and every bracketed marker stripped of its brackets. Every chemical name, locant, temperature, percentage, ratio and wavelength in this file was read off the image at magnification instead.
NO DRAWINGS AND NO TABLES. drawings is an empty array and that is a finding, not an omission: this page is two columns of body prose and carries no chemical structure, no scheme, no diffractogram and no table. illegible is likewise empty because the print is clean throughout; nothing on the page was unreadable. The table announced by the colon at the end of [0064] starts on the next page.
